title: Email/query collapseThreads=true does two full backend scans per request
description: email.rs:182-199: when collapseThreads=true, the handler first calls query_objects with limit=None (fetches all matching IDs), then collapse_by_thread (line 185) calls get_objects::<Email>(account_id, None, None) to read all emails for their thread_ids. Two full scans per request. The second scan at line 723-729 gets ALL emails in the account (not just matching ones from the query). Fix: query_objects should return thread_ids alongside ids (backend API change), or collapse_by_thread should only fetch the specific IDs from the query result rather than all emails.
